_comment: Collection banner: parallax off, overlay 50 -> 25. Claude Code, 2026-08-24.
enable_parallax scales the image up and pans it - the theme's own schema says 'Parallax crops images'
- so it was eating the bottom of the frame regardless of the aspect ratio supplied. The 50% overlay
at #1A1A1A was muting the picture to near-flat, which is why a new image read as no change.
Applies to every collection page, since they share templates/collection.json.
